subject: Two houses on the south side of Södra Långgatan, opposite pass 34: the wooden house (22, OSM 92379316) and the yellow palace with the stone portal (92379296), with their rear ranges.
author: Claude (Anthropic), 2026-09-24

registration.method: one straight camera track with the reported spacing (20.20 m "22"-"21", 20.50 m "21"-"18"), the facade on the OSM line and the wooden house's east joint on OSM; checked by two-panorama triangulation of window edges (within 0.1 m of the facade line on both wings)

fixed_during_the_pass: the wooden house's roof broken, with a steep lower slope as the west fire wall shows; the dormers stand on it (they first stood on a red front above the eaves)
the palace's ground-floor joinery 0.43 m behind the wall face (the oblique view shows deep reveals); the portal's piers 0.55 m wide instead of 0.80
the palace's roof dormers all 0.6 m behind the wall face with their tops at 13.8 (the east three first stood 0.15 m back and 10-11 px too high)
the palace's band from 4.25 instead of 4.12; the wooden house's band top at 2.40 instead of 2.48
the palace's pilasters 0.70 m wide instead of 0.80; dark door casings instead of light ones
the cornices and bands corrected for their projection; the wooden house's eaves at 5.85 (6.08 on the facade plane)
